environment: Single-user Arch workstation. Dotfiles live in a yadm repo whose worktree root is $HOME. The current project, /tmp and ~/.config are inside the trust boundary.
allow: Routine development the request plausibly covers, even when bundled or phrased indirectly: package installs, builds, tests, linters, git and yadm staging, commits and branches in the user's repos, project and isolated (tmux -L) test servers, reads and writes in the project, /tmp and ~/.config, and reads of system files.
soft_deny: Handling secrets: SSH keys, .env files, tokens, auth.json.
hard_deny: Any command that runs pkexec; the user must approve it.

git or yadm commands that discard uncommitted changes beyond named files: reset --hard or --merge, checkout or restore of `.`, a directory or a glob, clean -f, stash drop or clear. The worktree may hold other sessions' work. reset --soft, reset --keep and per-file checkout or restore are routine.
